headline: Approved $375,000 for affordable housing at 622 Auburn Street, a request for data center ordinance amendments, and Boyd and Cumberland housing district changes.
summary: Approved $375,000 from the Jill C. Duson Housing Trust Fund for Lambert Woods North at 622 Auburn Street. Also approved amendments to the Boyd Housing and Cumberland Housing tax increment financing district and a settlement with Geoffrey Rice and Trelawny Tenants Union. Authorized the Mayor to submit testimony to the Public Utilities Commission on Central Maine Power transmission upgrades, and requested ordinance amendments regulating data centers.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the 10.05.2026 meeting, 7-0.
Appointed directors of the Portland Widows' Wood Society for the 2026-2027 term, 7-0.
Granted municipal officers' approval of a Class I FSE license with outdoor dining for The Friendly Toast at 211 Fore Street, 7-0 as a consent item.
Granted municipal officers' approval of a Class I FSE license for Casco Bay Bar at 1001 Westbrook Street, 7-0 as a consent item.
Granted municipal officers' approval of a Class I FSE license for The Pub at PWM at 1001 Westbrook Street, 7-0 as a consent item.
Approved Resolve 4-26/27 requesting ordinance amendments regulating data centers in Portland, 7-0.
Approved Resolve 5-26/27 authorizing the Mayor to submit testimony to the Public Utilities Commission on Central Maine Power's transmission upgrade request, 7-0.
Approved Resolve 3-26/27 amending Council Rules as amended, 7-0.
Approved as an emergency the order approving a settlement agreement among the City of Portland, Geoffrey Rice, and Trelawny Tenants Union, 7-0.
Approved Order 55-26/27 amending the Boyd Housing and Cumberland Housing affordable housing development and tax increment financing district, 7-0.
Approved Order 56-26/27 amended credit enhancement agreement for the Boyd and Cumberland Housing district, 7-0.
Approved appropriating $375,000 from the Jill C. Duson Housing Trust Fund for Lambert Woods North at 622 Auburn Street, 7-0.
Approved Modification 3 to the Forest Avenue pedestrian crossing improvements project with the Maine Department of Transportation, 7-0.
Adopted the Civilian Police Review Board training procedures, 7-0.
Accepted and appropriated a Federal Emergency Management Agency Assistance to Firefighters Grant as an emergency, 7-0.
Accepted and appropriated a Department of Health and Human Services Drug Free Communities Grant as an emergency, 7-0.
